(define (find-first pred xs)
  (call/cc (lambda (return)
    (for-each (lambda (x) (if (pred x) (return x))) xs)
    'not-found)))
(display (list (find-first even? (list 1 3 8 5)) (find-first even? (list 1 3 5))))
(newline)

(define (product xs)
  (call/cc (lambda (return)
    (fold (lambda (x acc) (if (zero? x) (return 0) (* x acc))) 1 xs))))
(display (list (product (list 2 3 4)) (product (list 2 0 4))))
(newline)

(define (safe-div-all xs d)
  (call/cc (lambda (bail) (map (lambda (x) (if (zero? d) (bail 'no-divisor) (/ x d))) xs))))
(display (list (safe-div-all (list 4 8) 2) (safe-div-all (list 4 8) 0)))
(newline)

(define (with-early-exit body) (call/cc body))
(define (scan grid target)
  (with-early-exit (lambda (found)
    (for-each (lambda (row) (for-each (lambda (cell) (if (eq? cell target) (found 'hit))) row)) grid)
    'miss)))
(display (list (scan (list (list 'a 'b) (list 'c 'x)) 'x) (scan (list (list 'a 'b)) 'x)))
(newline)

(define (any-satisfying pred xs)
  (call/cc (lambda (yes) (for-each (lambda (x) (if (pred x) (yes x))) xs) #f)))
(display (list (any-satisfying negative? (list 3 -2 5)) (any-satisfying negative? (list 3 2 5))))
(newline)

(define log '())
(define (with-mode m thunk)
  (dynamic-wind (lambda () (set! log (cons (list 'enter m) log)))
                thunk
                (lambda () (set! log (cons (list 'leave m) log)))))
(display (list (with-mode 'draw (lambda () 'painted)) (reverse log)))
(newline)

(define depth 0)
(define (traced thunk) (dynamic-wind (lambda () (set! depth (+ depth 1))) thunk (lambda () (set! depth (- depth 1)))))
(display (list (traced (lambda () (traced (lambda () depth)))) 'after depth))
(newline)

(define held '())
(define (borrow name thunk)
  (dynamic-wind (lambda () (set! held (cons name held))) thunk (lambda () (set! held (cdr held)))))
(display (list (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) 'failed) (lambda () (borrow 'brush (lambda () (error "slipped"))))) 'still-held held))
(newline)

(define (with-restore get set new thunk)
  (let ((old (get))) (dynamic-wind (lambda () (set new)) thunk (lambda () (set old)))))
(define colour 'black)
(display (list (with-restore (lambda () colour) (lambda (v) (set! colour v)) 'red (lambda () colour)) 'after colour))
(newline)
